title: [Insert Name Here]
description: [Insert name Here] is a 1.21.1 modpack that has something for everyone, without having a steep learning curve!
body:
[Insert Name Here] Is a 1.21.1 modpack that has something for everyone!
The explorers get mods such as biomes o plenty, additional structures, and Terralith.
The builders get chipped,various furnature mods, and plushies!!
The PvP players get mods like the Musket mod, and basic weaponery.
The PvE players get new mobs from mods such as Rotten Creatures and illager invasion.
There are many other mods included in this modpack too!
